poll.source_locator: HMP release Sep 9, 2026: Tulchin Research, August 24-31; initial ballot 'Figures and Marques both receive 47% support'; informed ballot Figures 50, Marques 47
poll.notes: out_of_window: field end Aug 31, one day before the window; written because no AL-02 poll with fieldwork on/after Sep 1 was found. Release gives no n, MoE, undecided or mode (Wikipedia lists undecided 6; not used). New 2026 Alabama map; nominees Figures (D) and Marques (R).
